items.title: Patch release-critical correctness and safety gaps
items.hypothesis: The confirmed doctor, conversation, reconciliation, retention, scheduler, CI, and documentation defects can be fixed without changing retrieval semantics.
items.metric: Targeted tests and unchanged existing suite
items.stop_condition: Stop before live migration if any lineage, auth, or conversation safety test fails

items.title: Run the 20+ case full-corpus semantic and hybrid benchmark
items.hypothesis: The current full corpus meets 100% semantic candidate recall and at least 95% hybrid Top-1.
items.stop_condition: Stop on repeated auth/rate-limit errors or unsafe conversation behavior

items.title: Build capacity-aware automatic task enrollment
items.hypothesis: New eligible tasks can be explicitly enrolled through an atomic source-budget transaction.
items.variable: New task part count and reserve
items.metric: No silent omissions or over-cap plans
items.method: Fixture simulation then one live enrollment
items.stop_condition: Refuse the update when capacity or projection evidence is incomplete

items.title: Measure and optimize freshness profiles
items.hypothesis: A shorter quiet gate materially improves freshness without causing upload churn.
items.stop_condition: Reject profiles that exceed churn budget or regress reliability

items.title: Create the evidence-backed radar scorecard
items.hypothesis: A metric contract reveals the weakest axis and prevents subjective optimization.
items.metric: Coverage of measured axes and evidence age
items.method: Generate scorecard and radar from benchmark/operations reports
items.stop_condition: Leave any axis unknown when evidence is absent

items.title: Simulate 2x, 5x, and 10x corpus capacity
items.hypothesis: Deterministic sharding preserves complete-task locality and update headroom at larger scale.
items.metric: Shard count, fan-out, headroom, rebalance churn
items.stop_condition: Escalate architecture when query fan-out or rebalance cost crosses a defined budget

items.title: Compare local router plus NotebookLM fan-out
items.hypothesis: A local first-stage router can reduce remote calls while retaining semantic candidate recall.
items.metric: Recall, latency, and calls per query
items.method: Offline benchmark replay against architecture variants
items.stop_condition: Drop any variant below current candidate recall

items.title: Add content-addressed live source integrity evidence
items.hypothesis: Upstream APIs expose enough source content metadata to verify uploaded bytes rather than title alone.
items.method: Official API inspection and fake drift tests
items.stop_condition: Retain lineage-only checks if no reliable content evidence exists

items.title: Harden dependency reproducibility and vulnerability checks
items.hypothesis: A complete lock and audit can reproduce the runtime and surface known risk before release.
items.metric: Clean install equality and vulnerability findings
items.stop_condition: Block release on unresolved critical findings

items.title: Replace arbitrary oversized-line limits with bounded parsing
items.hypothesis: Streaming record parsing can preserve visible messages without an 8 MiB failure cliff.
items.stop_condition: Reject strategies that buffer whole giant records or change semantics

items.title: Optimize auth refresh cadence
items.hypothesis: TTL or refresh-on-failure reduces work without reducing unattended reliability.
items.method: Instrumented scheduler observation and expiry fixtures
items.stop_condition: Revert on repeated unattended auth regression

items.title: Prove multi-device ownership and failover
items.hypothesis: Explicit ownership rules prevent duplicate lineage during concurrent device operation.
items.method: Concurrent fixture simulation before live trial
items.stop_condition: Do not run live until all conflict fixtures pass
